svg.title: General event-sensitive condition waits
svg.desc: - make build passed; /tmp/condition-wait-build.log. -10 new public tests pass in17.177s; /tmp/condition-wait-fixed.log. Covers event response (<40ms median DOM lag and <50ms input/CSP lag), globals/time fallback, explicit await concurrency counter exactly[2,1,0], lexical globals/page.Boolean, page timer/Promise/Map/observer/listener/Math overrides, restrictive CSP, same/cross-origin navigation, false/throwing/malformed timeout, yielding self-mutation with no post-completion evaluations,20 alternating cancellation/absolute-deadline never-resolving predicates with matching-owner/same-public-ID reuse and capacity recovery. -19 runtime tests pass in59.825s; /tmp/condition-wait-runtime.log. -8 unchanged legacy waits/redirects/forms/invalid expressions/network idle/isolated-world wake tests pass in42.340s; /tmp/condition-wait-legacy.log. -5 idle cleanup tests pass in23.004s; /tmp/condition-wait-idle.log. -4 watch cleanup tests pass in9.729s; /tmp/condition-wait-watch.log. -4 request identity tests pass in12.719s; /tmp/condition-wait-identity.log. Total50 candidate checks passed, no skips. These are regression checks, not a claim that the fresh official control-latency gate passed; that campaign remains separate.
